readings.moment: When the temple struck nine, at the New Year's Eve dinner, when the men showed their watches to Aurèle
When the temple struck nine: the doctor's watch was two minutes ahead of the bell
When Dr Vauthier stopped playing piquet and went out to the hall to fetch his cigar case (a quarter to eleven by his watch)
When the temple struck ten during the piquet game in the salon
When the temple struck ten during the game: the salon clock showed five minutes to ten

whereabouts: Dr Vauthier dined with the family at the house on the last day of the year, as he does every year
At nine o'clock, Dr Vauthier was with the dinner party, where Aurèle had the men show him their watches
Dr Vauthier and Madame Monnier sat down to piquet in the salon
Dr Vauthier played piquet with Madame in the salon until a quarter to eleven by his watch
Dr Vauthier went out to the hall to fetch his cigar case from his coat
Madame Monnier began to play the piano as Dr Vauthier went out to the hall
Madame Monnier stopped playing the piano when Dr Vauthier came back
Dr Vauthier was in the salon with Madame during the game when the temple struck ten
Dr Vauthier is in the dining room for this interview
Dr Vauthier fetched his own cigar case
